_comment: Channel B retrieval eval set (roadmap R1). SSOT for the fixed query set used by dev/source/eval_retrieval.py. `expect_any` = PASS if ANY of these source_ids appears in the returned top_k. Keep queries SHORT (2-6 tokens) per the S183 governance rule 4 — real users type short queries. `expect_any: []` means 'record only, no assertion' (used for known design-boundary misses we still want to watch). S197: added four role-coordinator queries (senco_role / curr_coord_role / discipline_role / activity_role). The set previously had NO query whose expected source was a role_facts_* id, so a change removing or de-ranking the 109 approved_fact mirror chunks would have measured as zero regression while silently dropping the only place the platform states which post holds which duty. These four exist to make that trade-off visible.
_tie_aliases_comment: Same document ingested twice with identical chunk text → identical cosine → the order between them is inherently non-deterministic (verified S193: the unmodified build alternates 3:3 on repeat runs). Comparison treats them as one identity so this never reports a false regression.
